build_SimpleMaskDownSampler: build a SimpleMaskDownSampler to progressively downsample binary masks with configurable stride and channel expansion
create_CXBlock: create a ConvNeXt-style CXBlock with depthwise convolution, pointwise convolutions, and stochastic depth
build_SimpleFuser: build a SimpleFuser that stacks multiple CXBlock layers to fuse visual features with downsampled masks
